introduction: Ohio Medicaid provides health coverage for eligible residents. County Job and Family Services reviews the application and requested evidence.
description: Ohio Medicaid provides health coverage for eligible residents. County Job and Family Services reviews the application and requested evidence.

sections.who: Income, family size, age, disability and other conditions affect eligibility. Potential groups include low-income adults, pregnant people, children and people with disabilities.
sections.get: Coverage includes medical care and prescriptions; specialized services have additional rules. Check participating providers before making arrangements.
sections.docs:

  • Existing coverage and relevant medical information.
sections.apply:
1. Submit a request

    Use Ohio Benefits or contact your county JFS. The state Medicaid pharmacy portal lists 844-640-6446 for county application help.

  2. Provide verification

    Respond to the caseworker’s document requests.

  3. Read the decision

    Check coverage dates and any managed-care enrollment instructions.
sections.after: Keep your contact details current and respond to renewal requests. A preliminary eligibility check is not an approval.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using County Medicaid overview; State Medicaid pharmacy portal. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Does a screening tool enroll me?
No. Submit an application for a decision.
